entities.summary: Michael Angelo Saltarelli was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of Wilmington in Delaware from 1995 to 2008. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Newark in New Jersey from 1990 to 1995.
